REST API for the escrow-based wallet and payment system. Clients post jobs and fund escrow, workers quote and deliver, and admins resolve disputes and refunds.

This spec covers the public endpoints under `/api`. The M-Pesa (Daraja) server-to-server callbacks are not listed; they are described in `backend/README.md`. The internal trust-scoring service is documented in `trust-scoring-ml/README.md`.

## Authentication

Sign in with `POST /api/auth/login`. It returns a JWT (HS256) whose payload is `{ sub, role }`, valid for `JWT_EXPIRES_IN` (default 1 day). Send it on every other request as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Admins sign in the same way; they are created with `npm run seed:admin` and cannot self-register.

| Role | Can do |
|---|---|
| `client` | Post jobs, review applications, select a worker, pay and fund escrow, confirm work, request refunds, raise disputes |
| `worker` | Complete KYC, browse jobs, apply and edit quotes, mark work complete, raise disputes, withdraw to M-Pesa |
| `admin` | Process refunds, resolve disputes, manage users, view platform monitoring, compliance flags and KYC for disputed workers |

Each operation below states the role it needs. A missing, malformed or expired token returns `401`. A valid token with the wrong role returns `403`.

## Terms gate

Operations marked **Requires accepted terms** return `403` until the user has accepted the current terms version (`GET /api/terms`, then `POST /api/auth/accept-terms`). Admins are exempt. Login returns `termsAccepted` so the client knows whether to prompt.

## Errors

Every error has the same shape, `{ "error": "<message>" }`.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `400` | Invalid input. The message lists the failed checks, separated by `; ` |
| `401` | Missing, invalid or expired token, or wrong login credentials |
| `402` | Wallet balance too low |
| `403` | Wrong role, not the owner of the resource, terms not accepted, or account suspended |
| `404` | Resource not found, or unknown route (`Route not found: METHOD url`) |
| `409` | Conflict with the current state, for example funding an escrow twice |
| `502` / `503` | An upstream service failed: M-Pesa (Daraja), the exchange-rate feed or the trust-scoring service |
| `500` | `Internal server error` |

## Pagination

List endpoints return a page of results plus `nextCursor`, an ISO date-time that is `null` on the last page. Pass it back as `cursor` for the next page. `GET /api/admin/users` is the exception: it uses `startAfter` and omits `nextCursor` on the last page.
